about.paragraph: I'm a Lecturer in the Department of CSE at Bangladesh Army University of Science and Technology (BAUST), Saidpur. I completed my B.Sc. in CSE with a CGPA of 3.96 out of 4.00 (1st position) and am currently pursuing my M.Sc. at RUET. I combine a formal academic career, course design, and student mentorship with an active publication record in machine learning, lightweight deep learning, computer vision, and explainable AI (XAI). My current research focuses on video data analytics and multimodal architectures, and I'm seeking a Ph.D. or research-focused M.Sc. opportunity.

Co-supervised 6 undergraduate thesis groups, guiding them through research, experimentation, and publication.
Organized workshops and academic events on programming and robotics for students.
